purpose: Research-only three-level access grades with an Esri imagery check. NOT read by the app; the catalog registry (catalog/map_points/MO.json) carries the published status.

levels.verified: managing-agency launch feature (MDC boat ramp / NPS canoe-kayak access POI / USFS boat launch) within the NHD HR named-river limit and imagery pass / pass-ramp-head
levels.access-verified: agency-documented public access, but the coordinate is a conservation-area centroid, parking lot or recreation-area point, exceeds the NHD HR distance limit, or the imagery did not show a launch at the pin (approximate area)
levels.pending: no agency coordinate, identity unconfirmed, motorized-only, excluded (lake ramp), or imagery not graded

imageryVerdicts.pass: pin at the water's edge / launch
imageryVerdicts.pass-ramp-head: pin at the parking/ramp head with a visible route to water within ~40 m
imageryVerdicts.downgrade: verified candidate whose pin is not at a usable launch; published as access-verified

nhdHR.service: USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages

limitations: Esri tiles carry no capture date; Ozark gravel bars and channels move after floods, and NHD HR geometry can lag the current channel.
